name: std::error_category::error_category
intro:
1) Constructs the error category object.

2) Copy constructor is deleted. error_category is neither MoveConstructible nor CopyConstructible.

recommendedExamples.title: Related example: std::error_condition::assign
recommendedExamples.input: Represent invalid_argument, inspect it, copy it, and clear it. Error messages depend on the implementation.
